headline: New capacities and customer wins to drive growth

highlights: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Rossell Techsys (ROSTEC) CMP: ₹ 1383 Target ₹ 1625 (18%) Target Period: 12 months November 7, 2026 New capacities and customer wins to drive growth… About the stock : Rossell Techsys (RTL) is an aerospace and defence engineering and manufacturing company .

Space and semiconductor revenues have already crossed ₹140 crore in H1FY27 compared with ~₹100 crore in FY26, with management expecting these businesses to scale meaningfully over the coming quarters.

The company is targeting a 50:50 revenue mix between aerospace and defence and non-aerospace businesses by FY27E • Increasing value addition and operating leverage to support margin expansion : The company is gradually moving towards higher-value opportunities through system integration, MRO and advanced manufacturing, while expanding its presence across aerospace, defence, semiconductor and space customers.
Management remains confident of achieving its long-term EBITDA margin target of 18-23%, supported by operating leverage, scale benefits and execution efficiencies.
